title: Generate Test Nodes
description: Generate node credentials and NVS partition binaries for test nodes.
pageDescription: Generate node credentials and factory partition binaries for a batch of test nodes - ready to flash and provision.

form.title: Batch configuration
form.description: Choose how many test nodes to generate and what node data to include.

fields.matterHint: Produce Matter attestation certificates and commissioning data alongside RainMaker credentials.

info.title: Each node will get:
info.description: Everything needed to flash and provision one test node.
info.cert: ECDSA P-256 key pair and certificate (signed by auto-generated CA)
info.nvs: NVS partition binary (12 KB) with credentials
info.matterDac: DAC + PAI device attestation certificates (signed by the CHIP test PAI)
info.matterCommissioning: Matter commissioning data (discriminator, passcode, SPAKE2+ verifier)
info.matterNvs: Merged Matter + RainMaker NVS factory partition binary
info.matterQr: Matter onboarding QR code and manual pairing code

matterNotice.title: Matter: evaluation-only attestation certificates
matterNotice.description: Matter device attestation certificates (DACs) are signed with the CHIP Test PAI, which commissioners accept only for evaluation and testing. Production Matter devices require valid DACs issued under a real attestation chain — contact Espressif to obtain production Matter credentials.

config.missingEndpointDescription: Test node generation needs this deployment's IoT endpoint, which isn't configured. Set it in the environment or runtime configuration and reload before generating.

errors.countInteger: Enter a whole number of nodes.

status.generatingDescription: This may take a while. Do not close this window.
status.doneDescription: Download the package to keep the node credentials, then register the generated nodes.
status.errorFallback: Something went wrong while generating the test nodes. Please try again — if the problem persists, verify the deployment configuration.
